evidence_required: Focused PostgreSQL migration/model and domain-loop test results.
Boss, Engineer, Consultant, current grant, expiry, pH/EC evidence, archive, and restore matrix evidence.
Approval/action, action/follow-up, and Outcome/completion commit and rollback evidence.
Identical versus conflicting request fingerprint and concurrent natural-key evidence.
HTTP/OpenAPI/no-store/no-leak evidence and exact Timeline event cardinality with redaction.
Regression evidence that FT-004, FT-007, FT-008, FT-010, and FT-011 boundaries remain valid.
purpose: Provide one authoritative PostgreSQL and HTTP loop for matched ordinary tasks, current human Safety decisions, human action tracking, deterministic follow-up, and evidence-aware outcomes without automated actuation.
success_outcome: A matched safe_task_request creates exactly one ordinary check, measurement, or follow_up Task; an eligible current FT-011 pending decision can be approved or rejected exactly once, approval atomically creates one human action Task, action completion atomically creates one follow-up due 48 hours later, Outcome recording atomically completes that follow-up under the exact evidence policy, and every retry, conflict, expiry, audit failure, or archive race preserves PostgreSQL authority with no duplicate, Plant-state promotion, or device effect.
anti_goals: Do not implement the real task_follow_up model runtime in this task; TASK-040 owns external model egress and typed proposal orchestration.
Do not add a scheduler, worker, outbox, reminder executor, generic idempotency framework, pending-approval Task kind, cancelled/expired stored state, or second action proposal state machine.
Do not calculate targets, quantities, recipes, schedules, perform physical actions, or mutate confirmed Plant state.
Do not add frontend/PWA components, raw candidate/provider persistence, or a public arbitrary-task/agent invocation endpoint.

forbidden_scope: TASK-040 real task_follow_up provider request/result or credentialed model path.
Automated device commands, dosing, pumps, lights, actuator integrations, target values, or schedules.
Generic MessageEnvelope or Safety classification matrix widening.
Scheduler, worker, outbox, generic idempotency service, or hard delete.
stop_conditions: The implemented TASK-038 handoff differs materially from the immutable pending-decision contract or its current migration head is ambiguous.
Current ActorContext, Plant, Approval, Safety decision, or pH/EC evidence cannot be reloaded and locked in the owning write transaction without widening a public contract.
Approval and action Task, action completion and follow-up, or Outcome and follow-up completion cannot be made one PostgreSQL transaction.
The implementation would require raw candidate text as authority, automated actuation, a second proposal state machine, or Timeline replay as runtime state.
Existing uncommitted work makes the additive FT-012 migration or shared publication/main/writer edits unsafe to reconcile.

constraints: Task kinds are exactly check, measurement, action, and follow_up; states are open/completed, Approval is pending/approved/rejected, and Outcome is improved/worsened/unchanged/no_data.
Approval.valid_until copies the FT-011 expires_at exactly; now equal to valid_until is accepted and later time is denied without extending expiry.
Approve/reject reloads current ActorContext, active Plant, approval authority, immutable Safety decision, and selected pH/EC evidence; expected_version and request fingerprint must match.
Approved transition and its unique human action Task commit together; action completion and its unique +48-hour follow-up commit together; Outcome and follow-up completion commit together.

safe_task_request uses MessageEnvelope.run_id as its stable command request id and creates only the exact matching ordinary kind after persisted classification, current task authority, and same-Plant PostgreSQL reload of every source ref; it can never create action.
Timeline append failure rolls back the runtime mutation, while an already appended event after later DB failure remains non-authoritative noise and cannot replay state.
invariants: PostgreSQL is mutable Task, Approval, and Outcome authority; Timeline, UI Feed, Bus, MessageEnvelope, classification, and model output cannot independently transition records.
Human approval and Task completion record human-performed work only and never trigger automated actuation.
Consultant never creates or completes domain Tasks and never approves physical action; Engineer approval always requires the current active grant flag.
Non-no_data Outcomes require authorized evidence refs and never directly promote confirmed Plant state.
Archive preserves records unchanged and blocks every transition; restore does not replay, refresh, extend, or resume them.
verification_targets: Migration/model tests prove exact UUID/FK/enums/checks, restrictive deletes, natural uniqueness, request fingerprints, and the actual post-FT-011 head with all exact-head regression assertions advanced.
PostgreSQL read/write and concurrency tests prove identical duplicate versus conflict, parent-row lock behavior, and rollback for audit, task insert, follow-up insert, and Outcome insert failures.

Service tests prove matched ordinary kinds, same-Plant authoritative source-ref reload, Boss/Engineer/Consultant authority, immutable decision/version, pH/EC freshness, now==valid_until versus now>valid_until, and archive/grant races.

The full approved action flow produces one action Task, one follow-up due exactly 48 hours after completion, one evidence-valid Outcome, and exact Timeline event cardinality with no device or Plant-state effect.
HTTP/OpenAPI tests prove strict request/response unions, no-store, no-existence-leak, stable errors, redaction, idempotent retries, and no arbitrary task/action fields.
Focused FT-004, FT-007, FT-008, FT-010, and FT-011 regression plus the full deterministic suite preserve existing authority and context boundaries.
